note: A user with a signed-in gh gives the complete text of a skill-feedback issue and answers yes to filing exactly that text. The agent files it once through the feedback skill's script: exactly one create reaches the fake gh, with the title prefix, the skill-feedback label, the right repository and a body whose first line names the skills repository, and the answer reads the issue's address back. An unrelated closed issue already exists, so a duplicate search must not stop the filing. A second create would file a duplicate; the fake JIRA sees nothing, as the user's route is GitHub.
